part.label: Threaded Post And Nut
part.description: Two components side by side demonstrating both `thread` modes: `post` is a boss with a real external screw thread fused onto its outer surface (brepjs's real `thread()`), and `nut` is a tube with a real internal thread cut into its own bore. Neither is sized to mate with the other -- they're independent demonstrations of the feature, not a matched fastener pair.

components.description: A printed screw/threaded post: an M12-ish boss (12mm diameter, 10mm tall) with a 2mm-pitch external thread running its full height.
A printed threaded insert/nut: a tube (18mm outer, 12mm inner bore, 10mm tall) with an internal thread cut into its own inner bore.

features.description: External thread fused onto the post's outer surface.
Internal thread cut into the nut's own inner bore.
